findings.detail: Two wrong options repeat distractors from the earlier question M2-S33-T2. Option A (missing concrete input/output examples for inconsistent interpretation) repeats M2's wrong option about reformatting output with examples. Option D (no test suite written first) repeats M2's wrong option about a task already covered by a test suite. Both questions set the interview pattern against the same alternative refinement techniques, examples and test-first iteration, so more than one wrong option repeats. At most one may repeat.

blind_answer.reason: Handling duplicate deliveries and messages that fail on every attempt are failure modes in a domain the engineer didn't know. Neither was in the one-paragraph request, so the agent coded straight from what it was told. An interview step before implementing would have surfaced these unanticipated considerations (3.5-S3). The other options don't fit: A is about inconsistent interpretation of the format, C fails because the request was short, and D would require tests for issues the engineer never thought of.
